content.short: Crypto.com is a centralized Singapore-based cryptocurrency exchange offering buying and selling of 250+ cryptocurrencies, a Crypto.com Visa card, and developer API access.
content.description: Crypto.com is a centralized cryptocurrency exchange based in Singapore. Users can buy and sell over 250 digital assets and use the Crypto.com Visa card. Developers can use the API to connect to the exchange, access real-time market data, trade, and manage portfolios. The platform supports multiple chains including Ethereum, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, Polygon, Solana, Starknet, BNB Chain, Avalanche, ZKsync, Bitcoin, Tron, and Base. As of 2022, the company reports 50 million customers and 4,000 employees.
